publishedfiledetails.title: Carney
publishedfiledetails.file_description:
[url=http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=950485476][Click here for the single-player version][/url]

[hr][/hr]

[img]https://i.loli.net/2020/10/23/yi5E6p3ZHlvGYAh.jpg[/img]

Traveling Carney Cat
Possesses agile combat skills
Upgrade by walking and eating fish, with no level cap!
Easy to obtain increased gathering and killing drop multipliers
Can craft convenient and practical hats, shortswords, and backpacks
——Even death can't stop me from leveling up by walking!!

[hr][/hr]

[h1]Initial Attributes:[/h1]
[img]https://i.loli.net/2020/10/23/VNiFLMuI14KPtGQ.png[/img]
Each stat starts at 100, with a 25% movement speed bonus
Stats increase with level
Cold-sensitive - enters cold state earlier

[hr][/hr]

[h1]Infinite Leveling:[/h1]
Experience points (exp) to level up
Press J to view level and experience points

Gaining experience points gradually while walking
Gain experience points at a 1:1 ratio with monster's health when killing monsters
Eating fish dishes grants a large amount of experience points and additionally restores sanity

The experience cap increases with level
Leveling up increases stat caps, with each level granting +2 Hunger limit, +1 Sanity limit, and +1 Health limit
Also affects character skills and significantly restores health (20%)
No level cap

[hr][/hr]

[h1]Active Skills:[/h1]
[h3]——Dodge - Press R[/h3]
A small jump at the moment of pressing, entering an invincible state, negating all damage
A very short acceleration effect at the moment of pressing
Dodge has no cost
Character level affects the duration of the invincible state
[img]https://i.loli.net/2020/10/23/4dvQWGoiqOBEyZr.gif[/img]

[h3]——Charge - Press Z[/h3]
Empower the equipped item
Enhance the next attack by a certain multiplier, consuming 5 hunger after the attack
The charged state also emits a small range of light
Character level affects the damage multiplier of charge
Cancel charge when switching or unequipping the item
[img]https://i.loli.net/2020/10/23/q5FJ89pcGVahdHs.gif[/img]

[h3]——Ice Pillar/Blast - Press C[/h3]
Consume 15 hunger to create an ice pillar on the ground
Creatures within range will be slowed down and the temperature will drop sharply
Press C again to detonate at the location of the ice pillar
Causes damage to creatures within range, with more creatures leading to higher damage
Damage can be enhanced by the "Charge" skill
Character level affects the damage of the blast
[img]https://i.loli.net/2020/10/23/JHsFeaxRSVy1Kbp.gif[/img]

[h1]Passive Skills:[/h1]
[h3]——Gathering[/h3]
The higher the character level, the easier it is to obtain more items when gathering
An additional item is gained every 35 levels
The higher the character level, the easier it is to obtain more drops when killing
The probability is level/100, and after level 100, it is fixed at double drops
[h3]——Pet Never Hungry[/h3]
Summoned pets will not be hungry, and you will never hear the pet's hungry howl

[hr][/hr]

[h1]Exclusive Crafting:[/h1]
[h3]——White Beret[/h3]
[img]https://i.loli.net/2020/10/23/tBzAmUDTHYgEr34.png[/img]
Born with one, brain recovery +3 per minute, warmth 120, durability is the same as the Walrus Hat

[h3]——Breeze Dagger[/h3]
[img]https://i.loli.net/2020/10/23/wkfY3s18eGJSrgq.png[/img]
Increases movement speed by 25%, base attack power 27
Has a faster attack speed
There is a 30% chance to deal double damage with a critical hit
Inserting a dog tooth will automatically consume one dog tooth to repair 100% durability when low on durability
At 0 durability, there is a 100% critical hit, but the downside is a stumble
Enhance with gold blocks, each 5 gold increases attack power by 1
——As long as I pay, I am the boss

[h3]——Nylon Backpack[/h3]
[img]https://i.loli.net/2020/10/23/y12GLDOYtf9SWpN.png[/img]
Capacity of 14 slots
Warmth equals that of a Horned Hat (240), rain resistance 20%

[hr][/hr]

[h1]V2.0.0 Major Update:[/h1]

[h3]New - Learning Device[/h3]
[img]https://s2.loli.net/2024/09/30/u5TeCBwiR4KZQno.png[/img]
A versatile tool
Equip and right-click to open
Insert different tools to learn different functions and efficiencies
Currently supports learning functions: chop, chisel, dig, hammer, net, paddle, hoe, burn, fork, fresh water fishing, increase movement speed, teleport
Insert gold blocks to speed up work (100 blocks to max)
Removing the item cancels the corresponding function

[h3]New - HuHu minifan[/h3]
[img]https://s2.loli.net/2024/09/17/yIDXixptmeAQgL2.png[/img]
Speed increase by 15%
Equipped allows walking on water，can extinguish fire
Slowly restores the freshness of surrounding items and adjusts the temperature of surrounding characters while running
Feeding any food adds durability based on the absolute value of hunger and health, and durability can exceed the limit
Feeding is in stacks, and the effects of the food will take effect after feeding, such as glowing berries

[h3]New - Fluffy Ear Hat[/h3]
[img]https://s2.loli.net/2024/09/17/yhIG72Yg38F1Sf5.png[/img]
Made with a White Beret and a Walrus Hat
Warmth equals that of a Horned Hat (240), brain recovery 9 points per minute, durability equals that of a Walrus Hat
Additional 3 item slots, can be filled with fur items, enhancing warmth when inserted

[h3]New - Encyclopedia of Everything Cat Edition[/h3]
[img]https://s2.loli.net/2024/09/17/PqNLZfApa9OXykt.png[/img]
Reading grants inspiration points, which can accumulate
With points, unlock Science Two, Magic Two, and Navigation Technology
Unlocking a new technology reduces points by 1
Compared to the Grandma Edition, the benefit is knowing which technology is not unlocked

[h3]New - Quiet Whistle[/h3]
[img]https://s2.loli.net/2024/09/25/GqTyYCfenvkbaH7.png[/img]
Using it causes a small treasure house to emerge from the ground, a private cloud box, 15 slots
Different players see different items stored when opened
When closed, the items inside are preserved like they are packed with wrapping paper, permanently fresh
Switching worlds does not affect the items stored inside

[h3]New - Experience Retention[/h3]
[img]https://s2.loli.net/2024/09/17/2sUwGqKNktxYRPC.png[/img]
After reselecting or turning into a monkey, a shadow is left on the spot, which can only be picked up by oneself at first, and can be given to others after being picked up by oneself
After picking up, only the Carney Cat character can use it, and using it adds the experience points in the shadow to the current Carney Cat character
The durability of the shadow represents the experience points and level

[h3]Change - Breeze Short Sword[/h3]
Can upgrade in stacks with gold
Separate upgrade and repair, equipped allows right-clicking to open and insert dog teeth, automatically consumes one dog tooth to repair 100% durability when low on durability
At 0 durability, there is a 100% critical hit, but the downside is a stumble
Upgrading with gold no longer changes the short sword's durability limit
Axe function removed

[h3]Change - Other[/h3]
Skill Ice Pillar/Blast: Ice Pillar's freshness restoration function removed.
White Beret: Upgrading with Walrus Hat function removed.
Effects: Optim
ized jump and level-up effects.

[h3]Optimization - BUG Fixes[/h3]
Fixed room crash.
Fixed crash when dismantling mushroom farms with a disintegration wand.
Fixed slow attack speed of Breeze Short Sword with delay compensation enabled.
Multiple times gathering supports Monkey Grass, Banana Bush, and Shadow Harvester.
Players can gain experience if they hit the monster within 5 seconds before it dies.

[hr][/hr]

    [*] [h1] Search: [/h1]
    [*] Enter Key or Click: Search.
    [*] UP Key: Previous Input.
    [*] DOWN Key: Next Input or Clear.

[list]
    [*] This is a client only mod.

    [*] Other mod's items are in the „Mod Items“ tab.

    [*] This MOD can store World data. (can be turned off in the options)
    [*] Transfer data will be stored separately in different worlds. (Each World can have different custom waypoints)
    [*] [b]Controllers are not supported.[/b]

[h1] Warning: [/h1]
[list]
    [*] You can do everything with in-game Commands. This mod only provides a graphical interface.

publishedfiledetails.title: Boss Attack Predictor
publishedfiledetails.file_description:
Predict boss attack/respawn with displayed timer in a widget.
Also will display the time of Ruins Regeneration and Ancient Gateway Cooldown

Has same features as Hound Attack Predictor, and additionally also predicts Rift cycles

It will show the bosses who attack
- Antlion
- Bearger
- Deerclops
And the bosses who spawn
- Bee Queen
- Crab King
- Dragonfly
- Fruitfly
- Malbatross
- Klaus
- Toadstool
- Nightmare Werepig
- Scappy Werepig
And some extra timer
- Gateway Cooldown
- Ruins Reset

PS. Lord Fruit Fly is the least useful timer in this mod, the spawn mechanic does not depend on the timer but the plants you farm, so I suggest you disable it.

This mod is compatible with [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2885137047]UI Drag Zoom[/url] mod. You may freely drag the widgets if that mod is installed.

Note on mod configuration:
This mod uses client configuration when you join a server. If you are joining a game instead of hosting, you can change client configurations in the main menu > "Mods"; by "main menu" I am referring to the menu where there are buttons for "Browse Games", "Host Game", "Item Collection", etc. This way, different players on the same server may customize differently according to their own preferences.

GitHub: https://github.com/SperenzaNarra/dst_boss_atk_pred

Different kind of walls, you can open and close them, so they act like a doors. You can now close your base area and don't have to use hammer to get in/out and rebuild your walls. 

You can repair Wall Gates with wall segemnts or materials they are build with. 

You can open/close up to 4 segments at once. Just make sure to use middle segments to open/close them. 
If you want multiply entrances/exits from your base make sure they are 2 normal wall segments away from each other so they wont be affected by other Wall Gates. 

Wall Gates and Wall Gates items have golden glow when you mouseover them. 
Locked Wall Gates and Locked Wall Gates Itmes have blue glow when you mouseover them.

Locked versions behave like normal Wall Gates but only the person that build them can Lock/Unlock them.

You can set recipe for Wall Gates in mod configuration options. 
Gears (DEFAULT): Wall Segment + 2 x Goldnugget + Gears 
Electrical Doodad: Wall Segment + 2 x Goldnugget + Electrical Doodad

publishedfiledetails.title: Auto Actions - Full client mod
publishedfiledetails.file_description:
This mod will automatically equip the tool fit for the task at hand, and more to come.

Also, this is a client mod, which means that only you, the actual player, not any server, needs it. You can join ANY server and it'll still be working.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/A2HB41n.gif[/img]

A few examples of the mod's features:
- Hold space and get everything done without removing your finger.
- If any tools are needed for a task and you don't have it, the mod will automatically try to craft it for you.
- If enabled, you can re-fuel fires by right-clicking on the firepit.
- If you want a specific tool or weapon, mod or not, as your primary weapon, just equip it, hold down ctrl and press this mod's settings menu button, then you will automatically equip that tool or weapon when you attack something.
- Hovering your mouse over tasks which requires tools you don't have, will show a (Craft ****) option, which will craft the needed tool for you.
- If you have a nut from the same tree-type you are digging up a stump from, then it will replant the nut automatically.
- You can specify if you prefer normal or golden tools in the settings.
- Attack and enemy and it'll equip your best weapon.
- Attack a critter and it'll use a boomerang, if you have one. (Not on by default)
- Stand in the darkness and it'll equip a light-source, if one exists in your inventory, but it can also craft one for you automatically. (Not on by default)

[img]https://i.imgur.com/zjzpXGL.gif[/img]

Do notice:
- If you assigned a tool or weapon as your primary and you disconnected, then you'll have to reassign it.
- Holding space won't dig up saplings, bushes and such, but can be overwritten by also holding down CTRL.
- You tool type(normal/golden) can be overwritten by holding the CTRL button and hovering over a task that needs a tool.
- It won't automatically crafting nor show the crafting option, if you don't have the required materials or knowledge(made a prototype).
- If you let go of space after having digged the stump up, then it'll reset and won't replant the tree.
- If you wish to attack with a specific weapon while the feature is on, just equip the desired weapon/tool before fighting.
- There's in-game settings for the weapon, critter, etc. features, should you not wish to use them.
- Many of these functions are turned off by default, so you'll have to click on Mods and configure the features as you want them.

List of mods automatically supported in the mod:
"[DST]-Scythes" - "Will equip a scythe to cut grass and such, if you have a scythe in your inventory."

If any bugs comes up or there's something you would like to get implemented, then leave a comment here and I'll take a look at it.
Or if you have any ideas for improvements or compatibility with other mods, then feel free to post it too and I'll see what I can do :)

This mod is based on Auto-Equip, made by noobler, but has been fully modified, expanded and made into a client-mod by Jespercal (Me).

publishedfiledetails.file_description:
[h1]HololiveEN: Gawr Gura[/h1]
	
	
[h1]What is this mod?[/h1]
	It adds HololiveEN Vtuber, Gawr Gura in DST.
	SHAAAAAAAARRRRRRRKKKKKK!

	[img] https://steamuserimages-a.akamaihd.net/ugc/1665736384471740335/A0D8CCB29259086DB3F4F2AE41A4F80DDFB48B6A/ [/img]

[h1]Default Stats[/h1]

[img]https://imgur.com/Q24kQJH.png[/img]

[b]There is a huge config file enjoy it how you like it![/b]

[h1]A[/h1]

	Apex Predator.

	She gets hungry faster, but she will move faster on both land and water.
	She will also gain 20% more hunger when eating fish related food.

	Her base health is pretty small so you might want to be careful.

	She can also befriend Merms, but Pigs hates her.(Editable in the config!)
	Rabbits acts similar to normal characters towards her.

	Gura can craft Merm houses.

[h1]Hydrodynamic[/h1]

She can swim but only with a float. No one else can use them other than Gura.
She moves 20% faster on the water than on land because she is hydrodynamic.
Wetness also gives her sanity (If adjusted in the config). But getting wet will make food soggy.

[img]https://imgur.com/wC2ndMS.gif[/img]

	[b]Gura's Float[/b]
	[img]https://imgur.com/G3srTwS.png[/img]

	[b]Recipe[/b]
	[img]https://imgur.com/ZoTI0AF.png[/img] x 6

-----------------------------------------------------------

	[b] Trident [/b]
	[img] https://imgur.com/ufriXEE.png [/img]

    Multiple version that can be chosen in the config
[list]
    [*]Cheap
	[img]https://imgur.com/aMOj7kP.png[/img] x 3 [img]https://imgur.com/KpheKoT.png[/img] x 4 [img]https://imgur.com/zS5LX1c.png[/img] x 1

[/list]

(Almost everything is editable in the config)
[b][Strengths][/b]
Durability is a lot longer than a strident.
Spell damage is double of your normal hit's damage.
Possible to hit a single target multiple times with 1 spell.
Its damage is double when the user is on water.
Can be both Range and Melee.
Does splash damage which can hit multiple targets with 1 spell.
Doesn't damage followers as long as they are yours.

[b][Weakness][/b]
Kinda hard to aim and has a high chance of missing due to the slow animation.
Might enjoy using too much and break it. The durability isn't unlimited unless set in the config.
The casting animation is kinda slow. You might get killed if you don't distance yourself.
Normal hit damage is only as strong as a spear on land.
Other characters can't use it.

[i]- Lore -[/i]

Rin is a character from Touhou, a series of popular japanese games involving filling your screen with colorful and deadly projectiles.

[i]Rin is a feline demon with an energetic and positive personality. Her main occupation is carrying away the dead into The Underworld where she tosses them into the Hell of Blazing Fires to rekindle it and make it's power stronger.

One night, she was driving away vengeful spirits from the underground until she discovered a strange field, filled with corpses. As she was about to collect those unfortunate souls, a massive explosion occured at the site.

She has gone missing ever since... [/i]

[i]- Base Stats -[/i]

Health: [b]300[/b]
Hunger: [b]150[/b]
Sanity: [b]150[/b]

[i]- Perks -[/i]

[b][Servant of The Underworld][/b]

Your cat senses activate at Night, becoming nearly immune to The Darkness.
You are also slightly more resistant to Sanity draining effects.
You get slightly increased damage against most enemies.

Your night vision is very poor.
Becoming hungry will negatively affect your powers.

[b][Quick Reflexes][/b]

You walk and run around slightly faster.
You are slightly more resistant to slow and cold effects.

The effect becomes weaker the hungrier you are.

[b][Fishy Love][/b]

Eating fish restores a moderate amount of every stat.
Each fish will also permanently increase your Maximum Health by 1.
Cooked fish restores all stats for twice the amount.

After you hit the Maximum HP cap, the effect no longer works.
You get hungry a lot faster.
The effectivness of your other perks is based on how hungry you are.

[i]- Starting Items -[/i]

[b]Eye Bone[/b]
[b]Crow Feather[/b]
[b]Nightmare Fuel[/b]

[i]-Weakneses-[/i]

[b]The positive effects of your perks will turn into negative effects if you are hungry.[/b]

[b]Perks provide very small stat boosts and they are only relevant in the early stages of the game.[/b]

[b]While the Darkness no longer instantly kills you, you still can't see anything at night.
Don't abuse it, you are competely exposed and vulnerable when the lights go out.[/b]

[b]You have to rely on fishing as a primary tool for survival.
You get hungry often so you have to make a choice between eating to restore only Hunger right away or keep the fish for a long time for possible enemy encounters.[/b]

[b]It will take a lot of time and effort to get enough additional health for it to start making a difference.

[h1][i]Shiro[/i][/h1]

[b][Disclosure] I was commisioned to make this mod, thanks to the person who made this happen![/b]

[i]- Lore -[/i]

Shiro is one of the main characters from the anime: "No Game, No Life".

[i]One day, Shiro and her brother Sora were playing videogames, until a mysterious being claiming to be a god transported them into a fantasy world.
There they were faced with many challenges along the way, but nothing was a match for the legendary gamer duo, which eventually allowed them to rule over an entire kingdom.
The new queen of games Shiro suddenly stumbled upon a dark portal, curious to see what's beyond it, so she entered it alone.
Now she finds herself trapped in Don't Starve Together, while for others this grim world is quite unpleasant, for Shiro it's just another game. [/i]

[i]- Stats -[/i]

Health: [b]120[/b]
Hunger: [b]90[/b]
Sanity: [b]75[/b]

[i]- Perks -[/i]

[b][Level Up!][/b]

[i]You become stronger with each enemy you defeat.[/i]

Killing an enemy grants you a permanent boost of +1 to all base stats.
You can only double your starting stats.

[b][Genius][/b]

[i]Your knowledge has no limits, if you're in the mood.[/i]

You gain a bonus to crafting items, based on your current Sanity.
The more Sanity you have, the more things you remember how to craft.
The less Sanity you have, the more things you forget how to craft.

[b][Cuteness Overload][/b]

[i]You are so adorable, enemies feel bad for hitting you.[/i]
[i]Unfortunately, if they do decide to hit you, you get tired much faster.[/i]

You take less damage, if you are unarmed.
You take more damage if you have a weapon equipped.
Every time you take a hit from an enemy, it also drains your Hunger.

[b][Hidden Perk][/b]

You always carry a hidden plushie of your brother, which grants you a passive bonus: 

+10% Hunger Resistance
+10% Sanity Drain Resistance
+3% Cold Resistance
+3% Movement Speed

[spoiler]You can type in /bonesaw to play with your brother (Works only if you have no custom gloves on)[/spoiler]

[i]- Weakneses -[/i]

[b]Low starting stats.[/b]
[b]Can't take to many hits at once, or else you will be hungry very fast.[/b]
[b]Relies on killing mobs early on to acquire a decent amount of strength.[/b]
[b]Doesn't have her brother around.[/b]

[i]- Starting Items -[/i]

[b]Golden Axe[/b]
[b]Golden Shovel[/b]
[b]Golden Pickaxe[/b]
[b]Gears[/b]

[i]- Changelog -[/i]

(Last Update: 14.01.2017 - Version 1.0.7)

Version 0.8.8 - Allowed Shiro to play with her brother.
Version 0.9.0 - Made the character model mostly compatible with custom clothes, mostly.
Version 0.9.5 - Fixed that fancy hair color effect not changing based on lighting.
Version 1.0.0 - Steam Workshop Official Release.
Version 1.0.1 - Minor tweaks for better compatibility with other mods.
Version 1.0.2 - Removed some placeholder stuff and cleaned up mod files.
Version 1.0.3 - Fixed a bug where upgraded stats won't update properly.
Version 1.0.4 - Applied a solution to force changes to character stats to update more aggressively.
Version 1.0.5 - Character perk effects now reapply when you reload the game or go in and out of the Caves.
Version 1.0.6 - Fixed the game crashing while preloading character attributes.
Version 1.0.7 - Fixed Level Up! perk giving way too many stats.

[b][BUG?][/b]Due to the way stuff is coded, there appears to be a sort of a built-in delay on applying character stat changes, so what happens is when you kill an enemy your stat upgrade will not be displayed right away.
I have no idea what is causing this weird interaction, this might be just the way the game works, or it's just a update delay from other mods that show more info about your stats.
Don't worry, the upgrade perk does actually work and saves your new stats, but what you need to do is make it so that there is a change in your current stats, so for example: 
After you kill some monsters, if you eat something that heals you, or you take any damage - your new maximum Health with be updated and displayed correctly, if you get hungrier or lose sanity - it will show you your new stats.
Thankfully, this issue is mostly visual only and fixes itself during gameplay.
I highly recommend you to download any mod that gives you more info about your stats (like [b]Combined Status[/b], for example) and keep an eye on your maximum stats.
I'm sorry for the inconvenience this might have caused and thank you for playing with my mods and reporting bugs!

Also, check out my DST Touhou Characters: 
http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=701414094

[i][b]Cheers, Good Luck and Have Fun! ;)[/b][/i]
